title: Chakavanzika cheChigaro Choumambo Chiri Kure
intro: Mambo ane simba, akaropafadzwa nehutongi hunoshamisa, akatarisana nedambudziko rinoshamisa raisanganisira mambokadzi aibva kunyika iri kure. Mambo akaedza kuratidza simba raMwari neuchenjeri hwake, achitanga chiitiko chinoshamisa chaipesana nemitemo yenguva nenzvimbo. Unogona here kunzwisisa zvakadzama nezvechiitiko ichi chinoshamisa?
clues: Mutongi akapihwa simba guru, kusanganisira kutonga zvisikwa zvisingaonekwi uye kugona kutungamira mhepo.
Mutongi uyu akagamuchira nhau dzamambokadzi akapfuma ainamata zuva, ndokusarudza kumukoka kudare.
Mambokadzi asati asvika, mutongi akaratidza chishuwo chekumuunzira chigaro chake chesimba chinoshamisa kubva kuumambo hwake huri kure.
Jini rine simba rakabvuma kutora chinhu chacho mutongi asati asimuka kubva mudare rake.
Zvisinei, munhu ane ruzivo rwakadzama rweMagwaro aMwari akapa mukana wekutora bhuku racho nekukurumidza, achipedzisa basa racho nekukuruma kweziso.
Pakusvika kwacho, mutongi akarayira kuti chinhu chacho chishandurwe kuti zviongororwe pfungwa dzamambokadzi uye kunzwisisa kwake paakazosvika pamuzinda.
verse: It was said to her, "Enter the palace." But when she saw it, she thought it was a body of water and uncovered her shins. He said, "Indeed, it is a palace paved with glass." She said, "My Lord, indeed I have wronged myself, and I submit with Solomon to Allah, Lord of the worlds." (An-Naml 27:44)
arabic: قِيلَ لَهَا ادْخُلِي الصَّرْحَ ۖ فَلَمَّا رَأَتْهُ حَسِبَتْهُ لُجَّةً وَكَشَفَتْ عَن سَاقَيْهَا ۚ قَالَ إِنَّهُ صَرْحٌ مُّمَرَّدٌ مِّن قَوَارِيرَ ۗ قَالَتْ رَبِّ إِنِّي ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي وَأَسْلَمْتُ مَعَ سُلَيْمَانَ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ
